name: Alpha Accumulation for Voxel Cone Tracing
aliases: Correct alpha blending for voxel cone tracing
definition: A front-to-back blending method for accumulating alpha and color during cone tracing to prevent black staircase artifacts at voxel edges.
summary: Alpha accumulation is a front-to-back blending method for voxel cone tracing that prevents black staircase artifacts by correctly handling transparency and empty space.
